#: canopy-sandbox's template for chore commands: runtime.chore_cmd and a chore's own cmd (DESIGN §24).
canopy sandbox setup copies it to ~/.config/canopy/sandbox/chore.json; fill in your hosts there. Keys starting
with # are comments; @NAME@ strings are the paths canopy-sandbox fills in for each run.
Everything not listed is refused. Add your model provider's API host and the MCP services your chores read
A chore's cwd, by default <workspace>/.canopy/chores/<name>/, is readable and not writable: a chore's only
output is its result line. For a chore whose own tooling writes there, add @CWD@ to allowWrite. If your
workspace is outside HOME, add it to denyRead.
